method: Live browser UI actions through cua_repl Playwright locators and DOM observations

checks.coding_workflow: Explored, Edited diff, Ran exit 0, completed Markdown answer
checks.reasoning_transcript: Both earlier and later visible summaries retained; hidden in main conversation
checks.tool_disclosure: Expanded and collapsed in conversation and transcript
checks.steer: Enter showed Instruction pending, then consumed once at a tool boundary
checks.follow_up: Tab kept Queued follow-up until current turn completed; Play started the next turn
checks.interruption: Stopping then Interrupted; queued text restored as unsent input
checks.approval_once: Allowed branch produced install and test result records
checks.approval_session: Numeric 2 recorded session approval for npm install
checks.approval_denied: Keyboard focus followed Tab; Enter denied the selected request; tests unverified
checks.approval_cancelled: Escape recorded Approval cancelled; command not run
checks.failure: exit 1, assertion location and failed test retained
checks.markdown: Headings, emphasis, table, disabled task checkboxes and blockquote rendered
checks.partial_code_fence: Code rendered with syntax colors before closing fence arrived
checks.syntax_highlighting: Observed highlight.js syntax spans in TypeScript block
checks.copy_answer_source: Clipboard contained original Markdown heading, fenced code and table source
checks.file_preview: Link opened fixture line preview; Back restored conversation
checks.diff: Working-directory fixture showed guard and finally reset
checks.review: Review after coding did not repeat the fixed pending-flag finding
checks.motion: Activity animation observed; unchecking Motion changed animationName to none

limits: All model replies, tool results, review and file previews are fixtures.
No native TUI, SDK connection, model connection, filesystem tools, OS sandbox or process management implemented.
Browser modifier shortcuts are not claimed as native terminal verification; buttons and slash command fallbacks were used.
Native Unicode cell widths, IME, paste protocol, ANSI handling and renderer performance remain unverified.
The browser streams fixture blocks; it does not reproduce Codex's native line-commit implementation.
Mobile screenshot predates the final change of the approval footer hint from send to confirm.
